system.description:
Smarts; 5 Fire; Near (15 ft). Fuel (10): each Strike burns 1 fuel, and it can't be used once empty. Highly Flammable: a hit's Fire save is a CR 2 Luck Check, and failing it gives Burning (2) rather than Burning (1).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.140
